JOIN counted AS p ON p.catalog_kind = 'plate' AND p.slip_text COLLATE BINARY = d.slip_text

  "decision-cumulative-holdback-on-progress-bills": "WITH posted AS (

  FROM work_bill AS b

  FROM posted AS p JOIN hold_notice AS n ON n.job_code = p.job_code
)

  WHERE renewed_accounts IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY segment_code

  FROM pooled AS p JOIN segment_model AS m ON m.segment_code = p.segment_code

)
SELECT q.drawer_key, p.block_key AS plate_key, d.slip_key AS drawer_source, p.slip_key AS plate_source
